# support

`types.hpp` and `utility.hpp` define shared support primitives for `gamepad::unstable` controller code, including standard-library aliases and non-owning callable references.

## Contents

- [types.hpp](./types.hpp) re-exports standard-library types and utilities into `gamepad::unstable`, including `chrono`, `filesystem`, `path`, containers, synchronization types, smart pointers, optional values, variants, strings, spans, and forwarding helpers.
- [utility.hpp](./utility.hpp) defines `gamepad::unstable::function_ref<Return(Args...)>` with a `noexcept` constructor and callable `operator()`.

## API Surface

`gamepad::unstable::function_ref<Return(Args...)>` stores a callable address and erased callback, and `operator()(Args...) const` invokes the referenced callable.

## Behavioral Contracts

`function_ref(Callable&&) noexcept` is non-owning, so callers must keep the referenced callable alive for every `operator()(Args...) const` invocation.
